reasons.URGENCY_LANGUAGE: This message uses urgent, pressuring language to rush you into acting quickly.
reasons.THREAT_OF_ACCOUNT_BLOCK: This message threatens that your account, card or SIM will be blocked if you don't act immediately.
reasons.BANK_IMPERSONATION: This message pretends to be from your bank.
reasons.GOVT_AUTHORITY_IMPERSONATION: This message pretends to be from police, income tax, or another government authority.
reasons.COURIER_LOGISTICS_IMPERSONATION: This message pretends to be about a courier or parcel delivery.
reasons.UTILITY_IMPERSONATION: This message pretends to be about your electricity or gas connection.
reasons.OTP_OR_PIN_REQUEST: This message asks you to share an OTP, PIN or CVV. No genuine bank or company ever asks for this.
reasons.KYC_UPDATE_SCAM: This message asks you to urgently update your KYC through a link.
reasons.SUSPICIOUS_SHORTENED_LINK: This message contains a shortened link that hides the real website address.
reasons.SUSPICIOUS_IP_LINK: This message contains a link that points to a raw numeric address instead of a normal website name.
reasons.SUSPICIOUS_DOMAIN_MISMATCH: This message names a bank or authority, but the link does not go to that organisation's official website.
reasons.LOTTERY_OR_PRIZE_SCAM: This message claims you have won a lottery, lucky draw or prize.
reasons.JOB_OR_WORK_FROM_HOME_SCAM: This message offers an easy work-from-home job with unusually high daily earnings.
reasons.LOAN_OR_CREDIT_SCAM: This message offers an instant loan with no paperwork.
reasons.INSURANCE_POLICY_SCAM: This message claims there is a pending bonus or maturity amount on an insurance policy.
reasons.FAMILY_EMERGENCY_MONEY_REQUEST: This message claims to be a family member in an emergency, asking for money urgently.
reasons.REQUEST_FOR_PAYMENT_OR_UPI: This message asks you to pay money or scan a QR code.
reasons.UNKNOWN_SENDER_MASS_MESSAGE: This message was sent from a short bulk-messaging ID rather than a normal phone number.
reasons.NO_RISK_INDICATORS: No known scam patterns were found in this message.
reasons.AI_SEMANTIC_SCAM_PATTERN: Our AI reviewed the wording of this message and found it matches common scam patterns.

recommendations.SAFE: This message does not show signs of a common scam. Still, never share your OTP, PIN or bank details with anyone.
recommendations.LOW: Be a little careful. Do not click any link or share personal details until you are sure who sent this.
recommendations.MEDIUM: This message looks suspicious. Do not click any link, do not share any OTP or bank details, and check with your trusted contact before acting.
recommendations.HIGH: This message is likely a scam. Do not click the link, do not call back, and do not share any information. Talk to your trusted contact now.
recommendations.CRITICAL: This message is dangerous. Do not click, do not call, do not pay or share any details. Kavach is alerting your trusted contact.
